title: manageUnits
responsibility: Indexes and checks registered units, reports relationship and canonical ownership diagnostics, and retires source-free identities.

inputs.name: indexUnits.options
inputs.description: Optional options, default {}: root defaults to the discovered project; write defaults false and controls manifest writes. json and now do not affect indexing.

inputs.name: checkUnits.options
inputs.description: Optional options, default {}: root selects the project; other fields do not affect checking.

inputs.name: registryErrors.loaded
inputs.description: Loaded stored and freshly indexed manifests, source facts, scenarios, parse errors, formatting gaps and repository context.

inputs.name: retireUnit.id
inputs.description: Required registered identity to retire; its owned source must already be absent.

inputs.name: retireUnit.reason
inputs.description: Required nonblank retirement explanation, preserved in the tombstone.

inputs.name: retireUnit.options
inputs.description: Optional options, default {}: root selects the project and now defaults to the current ISO timestamp; json and write do not affect retirement.

inputs.name: renderIndex.report
inputs.description: Required index changes, active count, written paths and uncertain-reference count.

inputs.name: renderIndex.wrote
inputs.description: Required flag indicating whether manifest writes were requested; controls the follow-up instruction.

inputs.name: renderCheck.report
inputs.description: Required active-unit and uncertain-reference counts from the check result.

outputs.name: indexUnits
outputs.description: Index changes, active-unit and uncertain-reference counts, plus manifest paths actually written.

outputs.name: checkUnits
outputs.description: Active-unit and uncertain-reference counts, fresh/stored contract failure summaries and registry diagnostics.

outputs.name: registryErrors
outputs.description: All loading, contract, preview, scenario, staleness and ownership diagnostics; includes duplicate IDs and reviewed canonical forwarding backedges.

outputs.name: retireUnit
outputs.description: Persisted retired manifest with its stable identity, reason and timestamp.

outputs.name: renderIndex
outputs.description: Human-readable indexing summary, move/orphan details and a write instruction when needed.

outputs.name: renderCheck
outputs.description: Human-readable valid-registry summary with active-unit and uncertain-reference counts.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Retirement rejects an unknown ID, a blank reason or remaining owned source. Loading and filesystem failures propagate from dependencies.
